summary: 真实 albedo/normal 引导在首帧两块可靠不透明区域取得局部净改善：维持 OIDN 的降噪效果，门板线条、窗框、柱脚和地砖缝比同裁切仅颜色去噪更清楚，未见明显新增颗粒或光晕。保留为限定区域的离线可用选项；不据此推广到玻璃、水、透明边缘或连续动态。
chosen_route: Existing captured surface guides, offline CPU RT HDR OIDN on fully supported opaque rectangles.
why_this_route: No shader/host/sampling change or rebuild. Existing geometry/material/water readbacks are sufficient for a conservative first-frame opaque trial. Cloud primary64 and water64 require synchronized sampling/MIS/record-capacity changes and have larger current buffer costs.

implementation.guide_fields: Actual admitted primary geometry; material linear RGB[0:3] and mapped/oriented shading Ns[8:11].
implementation.selection: Primary hit, transmission=0, metallic=0, roughness>=0.5, full authored material alpha, no binary water support, finite in-range guides, and actual pre-rain==opaque RGB. Roughness restriction avoids sharp glossy transport; it is not a visual quality threshold.
implementation.filter: Official OIDN2.5.1 CPU RT HDR high float, 8 threads, clean_aux=false. Both arms receive identical color crop and automatic inputScale policy.
implementation.fallback: Only complete real-guide rectangles enter OIDN. Composite their interiors with a context ring and edge fade; keep cached color-only result everywhere else. Recompose actual rain with unchanged coverage.

local_visual_findings.noise: Both OIDN arms remove most visible grain relative to raw HDR. No separate reduction of noise power versus color-only is claimed.
local_visual_findings.clarity: Same-crop guided result preserves door panel lines, frame/base trim and paving seams more clearly than color-only.
local_visual_findings.artifacts: No obvious new grain, halo or seam seen in the reviewed crop/interior/full-frame images.

validation.timing_scope: Process wall time for CPU calls, separate from GPU timestamp sum and whole capture wall time. Cached full-frame OIDN cost is additional in a fresh workflow. No realtime or speedup claim.

cloud64_comparison.primary64: Potentially broader effect on wall/road direct-light noise; needs paired canonical MIS counts and factor-buffer sizing, retaining40bindings.
cloud64_comparison.water64: Only two water receiver direct-light paths; needs39-binding cloud64 source and finite controls. Current shared witness stride128->576 increases477producer scans.
cloud64_comparison.cost_limit: These are source-derived per-buffer sizes, not measured added resident peaks or whole-frame timing; primary and water buffers are distinct and are not added together here.

limits: Only two opaque rectangles in reset frame0 were guided; frame1 color includes existing temporal reconstruction and is not a matched-guide validation.
Glass, water, sky, unsupported material/coverage boundaries and remaining image regions use the prior fallback. Leaf detail and reflection/transmission guides are not established by this trial.
The application covers only26943pixels of640x360, including the edge blend; there is no claim of whole-image noise or sharpness acceptance.
Without a clean reference, newly visible texture cannot be proved completely accurate. Context-ring cropping is a practical local trial, not a full receptive-field boundary proof.
No1080p, continuous-motion or GPU-integrated denoising validation.
